_comment: Reference/target accuracy for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and the recorded single-P150 sweep. Fill 'reference' from the official Qwen model card (do not guess); 'measured' rows are populated by run_mmlu_bench.py runs so the BFP4 accuracy cost is tracked over time. NOTE: at 200 samples the standard error is ~2.9 points, so differences below ~3 points between rows are NOT resolvable -- treat them as 'no detectable change', not as a win or a regression.

reference.source: https://huggingface.co/Qwen (official model card — fill in verified numbers)

measured._note: One entry per config. The FIRST baseline this repo ever recorded is 'perf_flags_off' -- every earlier accuracy claim in the docs (79.0% / 79.5%) was from an unrecorded run. Decode tok/s is NOT measured here (see the harness docstring); use bench_decode.py.

perf_flags_off.config: pristine baseline: the 2026-08-22 perf flags all reverted

perf_flags_default.config: shipping defaults after the 2026-08-22 decode work (39.2 tok/s/user)

_paired_analysis._note: Per-question pairing of the two rows above (same seed, same 200 questions). The aggregate accuracy difference is not readable on its own at n=200; this is.
_paired_analysis.conclusion: No detectable difference. NOT a demonstration of no effect -- it bounds the effect below what 200 samples resolve.

measured._decode_path_note: MMLU is scored on PREFILL last-token logits, so it does NOT exercise the T==1-gated decode optimisations (se_gate_up/se_down/wk/w_in_proj/const_sparsity). Those are gated by tests/probe_teacher_forced_drift.py: 40L/96 steps, logit PCC mean 0.997283, median half-trend +1.3e-04 (stable), argmax 92/96, all flips on near-ties. Compare the shipped conv add-chain's 0.996.
